limitations: The three local skips are PowerShell parser, UTF-8 stdin transport and native-binding dispatch tests; pwsh is unavailable. Ubuntu CI runs these separately.

Terminal and app-server suites use harmless marker-only MCP fixtures. Native Write uses harmless JSON. These checks create no live chain/provider resources and establish no autonomous model reasoning, GUI, native macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager/ACL acceptance.

Late-cancellation terminal limitations remain: neither host showed the late warning or fixture lease identifier in its final interruption screen within two seconds. Claude received MCP cancellation and displayed phase progress; Codex did not observe MCP cancellation or phase progress in that window.
Native preservation and live testnet results are recorded in separate linked reports; harmless fixtures alone do not establish either requirement.

validation.method: validateHostReport(reviewedArchivedReport, { requireHistory: true }); assert.deepEqual(reviewedArchivedReport.sourceHashes, sourceHashes()); validateRelease(releaseRows); codexReleaseEligible(releaseRows) === true
validation.scope: Strict historical provenance plus exact current source equality; archived reports are not relabeled as current.
validation.note: The composed validation retains historical report status. It does not claim execution of the --release CLI, which requires a current fixture report. PR CI runs a fresh current fixture separately.

ci: PR CI runs independently on each commit. Check the preparation PR results for the reviewed revision.
timestampSemantics: createdAt records initial report creation; recordedAt and updatedAt record this assembled revision. Each check retains its own actual observation time. Metadata edits do not repeat those observations.

evidenceAmendments.scope: Documentation and provenance metadata only; original native Write artifacts copied byte-for-byte, preservation limitation spacing corrected, linked report digests recomputed. Recorded runtime observations and all 70 frozen source hashes remain unchanged.
